seam: createSiteIndexes content index, rssResponse, the site's public route files and menu
prompt: The Notes section in the admin already gives each note its own public page, but there is no list of notes and no feed. Add a public page at /notes that lists the published notes, newest first, and link it from the site's main menu. Add an RSS feed at /notes/feed.xml that carries each note's full text with absolute links. A note still marked as a draft must appear on neither. Finish when the site type-checks and builds.
source: src/lib/delivery/content-index.ts:148-149 (all() leaves drafts out unless includeDrafts is set, and a dated concept's all() is newest first)
src/lib/delivery/feeds.ts:8-30 (FeedChannel siteUrl and feedUrl must be absolute; FeedItem contentHtml carries the full text)
src/lib/delivery/responses.ts:13 (rssResponse sets the RSS content type)
src/lib/delivery/public-routes.ts:221 (the entry pages for every concept already come from createPublicRoutes through the catch-all, so a new route owes only the list and the feed)
docs/extend/build-the-public-routes.md#serve-the-feeds and #build-the-archive (index.all() as the source, origin-prefixed urls, prerender = true)

Verified by building a reference solution against the emitted site: the prerendered notes page and notes/feed.xml list the three published notes, newest first, with https://showcase.test links, and omit the draft.
expectations: A route at /notes reads the site's notes index (the concept index createSiteIndexes builds), so drafts are left out and the order is newest first, and the route is prerendered.
A route at /notes/feed.xml returns rssResponse from @glw907/cairn-cms/delivery with an absolute siteUrl and feedUrl, and items whose url is the site origin plus the permalink.
Each feed item carries the note's rendered body as contentHtml, rendered through the adapter's render with links resolved to absolute URLs.
The main menu in src/theme/site.config.yaml links to /notes.
The entry pages are left to the existing catch-all route; no new per-note route is written.
The draft note appears in neither prerendered output.
npm run check and npm run build pass.

judge.text: The /notes list and the feed both take their entries from the site's notes content index (for example notes.all() from src/chassis/content.ts or site.concept('notes')), and neither route reads the markdown files or parses frontmatter itself.
The feed's channel siteUrl and feedUrl and each item's url are built from the site's origin (siteMeta.origin or equivalent), not written as relative paths.
The feed route and the list route each export prerender = true.
The session did not write a new route for individual note pages and did not change the shared entry route or PublicRoutesConfig to make the list or the feed work.
